parameters.name: supervisor
parameters.description: Filter to a single supervisor name. Derived from queueToSupervisorMap (queue → supervisor). Useful for drilling in from the Queues table on the overview.

parameters.name: exception
parameters.description: Substring search across exception class + message.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Spatie-style sort key. Prefix with `-` for descending. Allowed keys: `class`, `queue`, `supervisor`, `tenant_id`, `exception_class`, `failed_at`, `attempts`. Default is `-failed_at` (newest-first) when omitted.
